rationale: Superintelligence most likely arrives in the 2030s, and because AI carries most of the doom and level-4 risk and plays out within roughly a decade of deployment, doom and level 4 rise fastest between 2030 and 2050 and then slow. War, civil breakdown and pandemics are treated as a roughly constant yearly hazard, while climate and resource-driven level-3 catastrophes are back-loaded after 2050, which keeps level 3 climbing steadily to 2100.
